limits: One newly owned Linux Agent is deliberately paused for a bounded observation window. Only its own project/builds are cancelled by the administrator; no role withdrawal. Ordinary account admission, actual state/counter observations, then one successful control. No universal assignment/ack timing inference when the captured state remains inconclusive.
